study: C1 batch control on Vast RTX3090; prospective new series
scope: Synthetic 70B-shaped NF4 fixture; guest 24 GiB GPU / ~30 GB RAM. Not reference 8 GB GPU or physical NVMe certification. Previous Colab batch results were observed and are excluded from new statistics.
schedule: For rounds 1..5, run pairs 1,2 then 1,3 then 2,3. Each pair is A-B-B-A in four fresh processes. Inspect first block before continuing; never concurrent GPU jobs or file transfers.
metrics: Per arm median synchronized step seconds; throughput=batch*512/median seconds. Also retain all step times, peak PyTorch allocated/reserved VRAM, sampled device VRAM and sampled process RSS; do not equate them. Report input tokens (not shifted-label tokens).
validity: All required F1 suspend/power/foreign_reads must be ok. Unknown/void/failure stops execution; retain whole block and exclude it from accepted statistics. Replace under a new ID only after cause review. No selective arm reuse. Same boot/GPU/fixture/code. Direct IO must be true; otherwise no disk-tier conclusion. GPU peer contamination or unexplained throttling requires review, not automatic acceptance.
oom: Retain CUDA OOM and logs; do not call it a timing sample. Verify no competing workload/config error before declaring batch infeasible. Comparisons involving that batch stop; complete remaining feasible pairs. Non-OOM errors are not infeasibility evidence.
repetitions: Use pinned F1 blocks_to_add separately per pair on per-arm median step seconds, only complete valid blocks. Five pilot blocks per pair; N=max(2,ceil(7.85*(pooled_sigma/(0.10*mean_A))**2)); pilot counts. Reach max(5,N), recompute once and top up once. Insufficient budget -> incomplete/no final verdict, never relax rule.
decision: Among feasible batches with complete required comparisons, rank by mean per-arm throughput pooled across accepted blocks; report pair-specific ratios and variability. Highest observed throughput is the operational winner on this box, not a significance or general-hardware claim. Gains below 10% described as below design target; inconsistent pair rankings -> no unique recommendation.
limits: No quality claim from synthetic data. Guest direct IO may still hit hypervisor/host cache. Guest disk controls do not prove physical-host isolation. GPU24GB results do not establish batch fit at8GB. No power/clock isolation claim beyond recorded sensors.
execution_caps: Each arm 40 min, each block 3 hours, no automatic long series. On timeout stop and report incomplete; timers do not stop billing.
preregistration: Commit this protocol and source manifest before first new Vast C1 training arm. Supply actual full commit SHA to runner and preserve Git evidence. A supplied SHA alone is not independently verified by remote runner.
